text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит faces the awesome sprint
of
Нарита Таисин, but manages to win
out by
matching her rival's fearsome
determination.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Taishin, though reluctant to admit it,
seems to
have gained a new respect for
Ticket's
wholehearted efforts.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She declares that she won't lose in their
next
encounter at the Satsuki Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит begins training to ensure
she wins
their next race as well.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
